assumptions.context: extractBoundary's hand-written tokenizer is intentionally a single function with state-machine shape (~100 lines, complexity 40) which trips eslint's max-lines-per-function and complexity rules

Use a regex (rejected — NFR-DR-S-011 forbids backtracking regex)
